user_request: Add breakfast at Breakfast Island, Chilika, to the food directory.

sources.retrieval: Visible browser page; main site JavaScript shell navigated via Dining link
sources.supported: Boat outing on Chilika with breakfast aboard and optional island walk. Public reservations phone +91 7800 208 002; email reservations@rambhapalace.com.
sources.limits: Does not identify landing island, offer daily service, guarantee food ashore, quote price, state nonresident access or exact departure point. Second displayed phone links incorrectly to first number; only first number used.

sources.supported: Breakfast Island located in Rambha Bay, between Badakuda and Somolo.
sources.limits: Not evidence of a restaurant or current meal service. Historical and alternative-name statements not used.

sources.supported: Operator promotes mornings at Breakfast Island.
sources.limits: Corroborates association, not a guarantee that its dining outing visits that island.

decision: Add an experience category, not a fixed restaurant on the island. Describe the named operator offering and ask travellers to confirm Breakfast Island in the booked route.
unresolved: Guest eligibility, schedule, price and menu
historical_naming_caution: CDA page, district gazetteer and tourist accounts differ around Breakfast/Beacon/Sankuda names and buildings; no history claim imported.
